list.name: converged / solver_status / gaede_status / statuses / reasons / ids / pareto ids / counts
iterations
list.definition: machine evaluations of the recirculation fixed point

list.name: every computed float

tolerance.abs_tol: 0, except: leak / recirculated / delivered kg/s maps 1e-12 x the vector's total inlet mass flow; residual (dimensionless) 1e-12; recirculation_frac 1e-12

list.definition: the identical damped fixed-point iteration (same update, damping 0.5, stopping test and iteration cap): iterates agree to rounding, so the solution bound is rounding-level, far below the solver's own RECIRC_RTOL 1e-4

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, statuses, reasons, ids, error classes, None / null, list lengths and orders, dict key SETS (Python dict insertion order carries no meaning in these records and is not compared), and floats that are copied (not computed): equal (floats by value, -0.0 == 0.0; non-finite floats are transported as the strings 'NaN', '+inf', '-inf' and compared as strings)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py) OR |rust - py| <= r_rel * |py| OR |rust - py| <= a_abs, k_ulp / r_rel / a_abs fixed per observable group below (an absent clause is not applied); relative clause scaled by |py| (not max(1, |py|)): the observables span 1e-30 .. 1e9. ulp(py) = math.ulp(py)
tolerance_classes.SOLVER_TOLERANCE: convergence / solver status EXACT_VALUE; solution |rust - py| <= abs_tol + rel_tol * |py| with abs_tol / rel_tol fixed per entry below and tied to the solver's own tolerance; iteration and function-evaluation counts reported, not scored
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: not used (no RNG in either implementation)

tolerance_basis.registered: DragCompressor, rotor_strength and compressor_synthesis evaluate Python floats only (no numpy); the Rust port repeats every operation in the reference order with the same libm calls (exp, sqrt, pow) and the same Python exception semantics (ZeroDivisionError on a zero divisor, OverflowError on exp overflow, ValueError on a sqrt domain error), so bit-identical results are expected. k_ulp 4 / r_rel 1e-12 (closed form) and r_rel 1e-10 (40 fixed-point iterations, 60-step searches) bound a few-ulp libm difference amplified through the Gaede cascade
